description: Schema definition used to create the Review table (layer 5/9 of the Poutine League Dataverse data model build-out). Source of truth: ARCHITECTURE.md §1 (Data model), REVIEW entity block and ER diagram (TRY ||--o| REVIEW : "rated by"). Review = a star rating (1-5) plus comment left after a Try, with an AI-assessed helpfulness score populated later by a backend agent (out of scope here, left null).

table.purpose: Rating + comment left after a Try. Links a Try (layer 4) to the reviewer (systemuser), carries a required star rating (1-5), an optional multiline comment, and a nullable AI-assessed helpfulness score populated later by the Review Quality backend agent (out of scope for this layer).

columns.notes: Primary name column, auto-created with the table. No natural name exists for a Review record; seed data composes '<Try name> reviewed by <employee>' as the value.
See NEW GOTCHA in creationMethod below -- RequiredLevel and Min/MaxValue are not exposed by the SDK's generic 'int' type string and had to be set via a raw Web API PUT after column creation.

Multiline text. Must use the SDK's 'memo' type string in add_columns() -- the generic 'string' type string creates a single-line text column instead. This column was initially created as 'string' by mistake, then deleted and recreated as 'memo'.
AI-assessed helpfulness score. Nullable/optional by design -- populated later by the Review Quality backend agent (out of scope for this layer). Left null for all sample rows seeded here.

lookups.creationMethod: client.tables.create_lookup_field() -- worked as-is because the referenced table (rpo_try) already carries the rpo customization prefix, so the SDK's auto-generated relationship schema name is valid.

client.tables.create_lookup_field() FAILS for lookups to systemuser (documented gotcha from prior layers: auto-generated relationship schema name lacks a customization prefix). Worked around by calling client.tables.create_one_to_many_relationship() directly with LookupAttributeMetadata + OneToManyRelationshipMetadata, supplying an explicit rpo_-prefixed relationship schema name ('rpo_Review_Reviewer'), matching the rpo_Try_Employee pattern from layer 4.

solutionAttachment.verificationMethod: Queried solutioncomponent for componenttype=1 and confirmed the rpo_review table (metadata GUID 49fe945c-59b7-4cb1-ba0f-82ce960409e9) is present in poutineleaguecore, attached automatically via the solution= parameter on client.tables.create() (no pac solution add-solution-component call was needed). Confirmed both rpo_try_rpo_review_rpo_TryId and rpo_Review_Reviewer relationships appear in the final pac solution export used for this PR (solutions/poutineleaguecore/Other/Relationships/rpo_Try.xml and Relationships/SystemUser.xml).

creationMethod.tool: PowerPlatform-Dataverse-Client (Python SDK) with raw Web API fallback for RequiredLevel/Min/MaxValue on rpo_starrating.
creationMethod.phasedCreation: Table + rpo_StarRating/rpo_Comment/rpo_HelpfulnessScore columns first, then a fixup pass (delete+recreate rpo_Comment as memo; raw Web API PUT for rpo_StarRating constraints), then both lookups, waiting for metadata propagation between phases.
creationMethod.newGotcha_requiredLevelAndMinMax: Creating an Integer column via the SDK's generic add_columns()/create() 'int' type string does not expose RequiredLevel or MinValue/MaxValue -- the column is created as optional with the SDK's default numeric range. Fix: raw Web API PUT to EntityDefinitions(LogicalName='rpo_review')/Attributes(LogicalName='rpo_starrating')/Microsoft.Dynamics.CRM.IntegerAttributeMetadata with RequiredLevel.Value='ApplicationRequired', MinValue=1, MaxValue=5, plus the MSCRM.SolutionName header. This succeeded (204 response). Recommendation for future layers: always set RequiredLevel and Min/MaxValue on Integer/Decimal columns via raw Web API immediately after creation via the SDK, rather than relying on generic type-string parameters.
creationMethod.newGotcha_memoTypeString: The SDK's generic 'string' type string in add_columns() always creates a single-line text (String) column, never multiline (Memo) -- there is no format parameter to request multiline via the generic string type. Use the 'memo' type string explicitly instead. rpo_Comment was initially created with 'string' by mistake and had to be deleted and recreated with 'memo'.
creationMethod.verificationLimitation: client.tables.list_columns() does not support MinValue/MaxValue in select= on the base AttributeMetadata type (400 error: "Could not find a property named 'MinValue'"). Min/Max constraint success was confirmed via the raw Web API PUT's 204 response only, not re-verified by reading it back with a type-cast query.
